dina (docs): Quick coordination: I opened a small PR to update the streaming + pagination examples for migration to async iterators and to call out runtime retry behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4699. Can SDK folks sanity-check py/ts/go snippets?

kai (sdk): on it. we'll keep a short compatibility note for sync users.

lucy (eng): runtime note: automatic retries now issue a Retry-Token and clear per-request KV prefix cache. Docs should instruct to fetch the cursor with the token and resume.

dina (docs): suggested copy we can paste: "Note: retried streams get a new Retry-Token and the service clears per-request KV prefix cache. Re-fetch the cursor with the Retry-Token before resuming pagination."

omar (pm): add a 3-step migration checklist (detect retry, fetch cursor, resume) and one-line captions for each language.

kai (sdk): Python snippet (tiny):

```python
# python: async resume
async for s in client.stream_responses(model="open-3", input=prompt):
  try:
    async for p in s.paginate(): yield p
  except TransientError:
    cursor = await client.get_cursor_from_retry(s.retry_token)
    async for p in client.resume_pages(cursor): yield p
```

kai (sdk): TypeScript (tiny):

```ts
// ts: iterator + resume
for await (const s of client.streamResponses({model:'open-3', input})) {
  try { for await (const p of s.paginate()) yield p }
  catch { const c = await client.getCursorFromRetry(s.retryToken); for await (const p of client.resumePages(c)) yield p }
}
```

kai (sdk): Go (tiny):

```go
// go: resume stream
st, _ := c.StreamResponses(ctx, params)
for st.Next() {
  pages, err := st.Pages()
  if err != nil { token,_:=st.RetryToken(); cur,_:=c.GetCursorFromRetry(ctx, token); resumed:=c.ResumeStream(ctx, cur); /* iterate resumed */ }
}
```

lucy (eng): looks good. add brief note: Retry-Token may be missing for manual retries; fallback to full re-query.

dina (docs): will add captions: "Python — async resume", "TypeScript — iterator + resume", "Go — resume stream" and frontmatter tags [streaming,migration,pagination,retry]. Also adding the 3-step checklist in PR description.
